text:
sophia: Heads-up — prod docs build failing on main. docusaurus linkcheck errors out on an inline MDX link with parentheses in the fragment.
kevin: can you paste the failing snippet + exact CI error?
sophia: CI output: "Error: Invalid href in MDX: './sdk#init(params)' — parser treats parens as part of anchor and chokes"

sophia: failing snippet from docs/snippets/quickstart.mdx:
```
// docs/snippets/quickstart.mdx
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  url: '/api/models',
  init: params => client.init(params)
});
// link in doc: [init example](./sdk#init(params))
```

kevin: aha. MDX/linkcheck wants the parens escaped or encoded. Quick options: URL-encode the paren (`#init%28params%29`) or wrap the URL in angle brackets: `<./sdk#init(params)>`. Either fixes the parser.
sophia: pushing a tiny patch to replace with encoded fragment - will open PR in a sec.
ci-bot: docs-ci-linkcheck (run 54812) failed: 4 linkcheck errors, first is docs/snippets/quickstart.mdx: ./sdk#init(params)

sophia: PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 - replaces `#init(params)` with `#init%28params%29` and normalizes a couple of other inline examples.
maya: quick review — looks good from docs POV :thumbsup:
kevin: lgtm, small and safe. can you backport to v1-stable? release build hit the same issue.
sophia: will open backport PR after merge.
chris: please tag release team in the backport so the release job picks it up.
sophia: backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/843 (targets v1-stable).
kevin: merging main PR now — merging + triggering CI. :shipit:
ci-bot: merge complete. re-running docs-ci-linkcheck for main.
ci-bot: docs-ci-linkcheck (run 54813) succeeded — linkcheck passed for changed files.
chris: thanks all, clearing the blocker.
kevin: note for follow-up: add a small linkcheck unit in our snippet-lint harness to catch unencoded parens in fragments (caught this blind spot).
sophia: filed follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/429 — will include test in next docs PR.
kevin: nice. closing loop.
